   tabularized; formation into tables; tabulation.

tabularize.definition: v arrange or enter in tabular form
tabularize.translation: vt.把(事实、数字等)列成表格, 把…排成表格式

tabularized.translation:
把(事实、数字等)列成表格
把…排成表格式

tabularizing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Tabularize
tabularizing.translation:
把(事实、数字等)列成表格
把…排成表格式

tabulata.definition:
n. pl. An artificial group of stony corals including those
   which have transverse septa in the calicles. The genera Pocillopora and
   Favosites are examples.
tabulata.translation: 横板珊瑚亚纲, 床板珊瑚

tabulate.definition: v. shape or cut with a flat surface
tabulate.translation:
vt. 作成表, 作成一览表, 使成平面
a. 平板状的, 平面的
[计] 制表

tabulated.definition:
v arrange or enter in tabular form
v shape or cut with a flat surface
tabulated.translation: v. 把（数字、事实）列成表( tabulate的过去式和过去分词 )

tabulates.definition:
v arrange or enter in tabular form
v shape or cut with a flat surface
tabulates.translation: v. 把（数字、事实）列成表( tabulate的第三人称单数 )

tabulating.definition:
v arrange or enter in tabular form
v shape or cut with a flat surface

tabulating result.translation: [计] 列表结果, 制表结果

tabulation.definition:
n. information set out in tabular form
n. the act of putting into tabular form
tabulation.translation:
n. 作表, 表格
[经] 制表, 列表

tabulations.definition:
plural of tabulation
n. information set out in tabular form
n. the act of putting into tabular form
tabulations.translation:
(tabulation 的复数) n. 作表, 表格
[经] 制表, 列表

tabulator.definition: n a calculator that keeps a record of the number of times something happens
tabulator.translation:
n. 制表人, 定位装置
[计] 制表机

tabulator card.translation: [计] 制表机卡片, 制表程序卡

tabulators.definition: n. a calculator that keeps a record of the number of times something happens
tabulators.translation: n. 作表的人, 制表机, （打字机上为制表用的）跳格键( tabulator的复数形式 )

tabun.definition: n the first known nerve agent, synthesized by German chemists in 1936; a highly toxic combustible liquid that is soluble in organic solvents and is used as a nerve gas in chemical warfare
tabun.translation: n. [亦作T-][化]塔崩(一种神经性毒剂)
